definitions: A gradual diminution in the strength, intensity, or visibility of something.
A hairstyle in which the hair is cut very short on the sides and back and gradually gets longer towards the top.
A shot in golf or other ball games that curves slightly to the right (for a right-handed player).
examples: The fade of the colours was noticeable.
He got a fresh fade at the barber's.
She hit a perfect fade onto the green.
